technologies.name: Automated Extraction
technologies.description: Unlock extractors that harvest a field within one hex.

technologies.name: Composition
technologies.description: Unlock component composers and the landing objective path.

technologies.name: Storage Planning
technologies.description: Optional branch that unlocks exact-quantity containers.

technologies.name: Material Processing
technologies.description: Unlock the smelter and the kiln, and with them plate, glass, brick, and charcoal.

technologies.name: Mechanical Shaping
technologies.description: Unlock the cutter and the crusher, which turn wood and stone into timber and gravel.

technologies.name: Hydrology
technologies.description: Unlock the pump, so a basin becomes a reason to build beside it.

technologies.name: On-site Power
technologies.description: Unlock poles and the burner generator, so a region can afford to run.

technologies.name: Sited Generation
technologies.description: Unlock wind on the ridges and hydro at the basin edge.

technologies.name: Steam Works
technologies.description: Unlock the boiler and turbine pair. Water rides belts; this is not a fluid network.

technologies.name: Corner Transport
technologies.description: Teach the belt the six vertex headings between the ordinary hex edges. A corner belt spans two rows for twice the price, so the reach is a choice rather than a replacement.

technologies.name: Machine Tiers
technologies.description: Unlock the deep extractor and the deep container, and the upgrade that grows one into the other in place.

technologies.name: Transmission
technologies.description: Unlock the relay pole, and the upgrade that grows a pole into one in place. A wider disc means fewer poles between the plant and the work.

technologies.name: Grid Engineering
technologies.description: Unlock the trunk pole, which spans twelve hexes to the next. A line of them reaches a site too far to give its own generator.

technologies.name: Shallow Crossings
technologies.description: Unlock stone-and-timber bridge decks for carrying transport across shallow water.

technologies.name: Belt Junctions
technologies.description: Unlock the splitter and the merger. One divides a lane between every output that will take it; the other takes from its feeders in turn, so no line that shares a junction starves another.

technologies.name: Grade Separation
technologies.description: Unlock the underpass. A pair of them carries a lane beneath up to four hexes of anything already built, so two belt lines can finally cross.

technologies.name: Fired Masonry
technologies.description: Lay brick and concrete walls. Cement is fired from hill limestone and clay; concrete binds that cement with gravel, sand and water. Timber and wire fences stay free of this node.

branches.name: Masonry
branches.description: Firing, cement, concrete and brick construction.

branches.name: Metallurgy
branches.description: Metal processing; the legacy Material Processing bundle also includes firing.

branches.name: Manufacturing
branches.description: Extraction, assembly and industrial machine improvements.

branches.name: Plumbing
branches.description: Water collection; current water travels as belt cargo, not in pipes.

stages.name: Foundations
stages.description: Recover and make essentials from local resources.

stages.name: Workshops
stages.description: Useful material processing and first automation.

stages.name: Industrial systems
stages.description: Combine processes and distribution into sustained production.

skills.name: Expanded Pack
skills.description: Four more cargo slots for supplies, spare parts and the trip home.

skills.name: Surveyed Construction
skills.description: Build three hexes farther from where you stand. Terrain and placement rules still apply.

skill_milestones.name: Made by hand
skill_milestones.description: Finish one batch at a manual workshop. Choose a recipe, supply its inputs and stay beside it while working.

skill_milestones.name: Prove the line
skill_milestones.description: Deliver the component for the founding commission at your landing hub.

skill_milestones.name: Power at work
skill_milestones.description: Finish one batch in an electrically powered processing machine. Connect power and supply a recipe.
